name: Fukuchi (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Fukuchi town emblem in light blue and green: a light blue disc with a green base and a white stylised letter F.
history: Municipal flag of Fukuchi, a town in Fukuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 8 March 2006.

features.role: Fukuchi town emblem — a light blue disc with a green base and a white stylised letter F
